title: OpenCode provides temporary free access to GLM-5.3-Flash
summary: OpenCode opened temporary access to Zhipu's GLM-5.3-Flash mixture-of-experts model for coding and agent workflows. The release provides 18B active parameters from a 320B parameter total, image and tool execution, a 200K token context window, and zero retention of request data.
research_notes:
Install or open the OpenCode terminal developer environment.

Select GLM-5.3-Flash from the available programming model options.

Dispatch coding, tool-calling, or visual analysis tasks within the 200K-token context limit under the zero-retention privacy policy.

Bound agent working context within 200K tokens to stay within the free-tier limit and avoid context truncation during extended repository sessions.

Structure agent workflows around native tool calling and multimodal inputs rather than text-only completion to utilize the model's specialized MoE activation routing.
